# f5xc_user (Data Source)

Represents user for a given tenant

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: User - Full

data "f5xc_user" "example" {
  email     = f5xc_user.example.email
  namespace = f5xc_user.example.namespace
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `creation_timestamp` (String) Creation timestamp Timestamp of user creation.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disabled If set to true user is completely disabled including IDM.
- `domain_owner` (Boolean) Domain Owner Domain owner is the first user who registered or signed up the associated Tenant. User created via signup flow will have this value set to true. Few restrictions apply to this user w.r.t role update and deletion.
- `email` (String) Email Email of the user object
- `first_name` (String) First name First name of the customer
- `group_names` (List of String) Groups Group list must be associated to this user.
- `idm_type` (List of String) IDM type Identity management type of the user (F5XC Managed, SSO)
- `last_login_timestamp` (String) Last login timestamp Last login timestamp when user successfully login to access VoltConsole.
- `last_name` (String) Last name Last name of the customer
- `name` (String) Name name of the user
- `namespace` (String) Namespace Namespace of the user object (namespace where the user object is stored).
- `namespace_roles` (Attributes List) Namespace roles List of directly attached roles that the user has for each namespace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespace_roles))
- `otp_enabled` (Boolean) OTP Enabled Shows if OTP is enabled in IDM Provider.
- `sync_mode` (List of String) Sync Mode Denotes if this is an externally managed entity imported into UAM by SCIM protocol, or self managed.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant tenant that the user belongs to
- `tenant_type` (List of String) Tenant type tenant type of the user (FREEMIUM, ENTERPRISE, ...)
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `type` (List of String) User type Type of the user account (USER, SERVICE)

- `namespace` (String) Namespace Namespace the role applies to '*' value implies all namespaces
